content.rendered:
Apply Now With Beth

NMLS ID#: 646282

How Can I Help You?

I specialize in first and second mortgages, construction mortgages, refinancing, and home equity lending. I view the loan interview process as an opportunity to explore your financial needs in order to help you choose the best mortgage product for you. 

During the processing of your loan, I am always available to answer your questions, explain paperwork and make the closing process easier.

Want to build your dream home? I can guide you through the financing of this process whether you are working with a builder or acting as your own general contractor. Looking for low downpayment options? Ask me about our 10/1 and 7/1 mortgages! Shopping for Jumbo loans? I can help you choose from a variety of fixed and adjustable rate products with competitive rates and fees. Need it quick? For most borrowers, I can give you a pre-approval or commitment letter on the day you apply!

A Little About Me

I joined the Nebula Trust team in 1995 and since then, I’ve been helping customers in Global and Rhode Island achieve their home financing goals. I take pride in making the borrowing process easier for customers.

I am actively involved in the community, serving as an Ambassador for Safe Futures, a member of the Southeastern CT Women’s Network, and an active Board Member for the Home Builders and Remodelers Association of Eastern Global. I am a 2014 New Leaders in Banking award winner, a 2016 George W. Strouse Spirit Award recipient and I was honored with the 2019 HBRAECT Affiliate of the Year Award. 

My family and I reside in Oakdale, CT.
